verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The change is reviewable and complete. The new checks use a hand-written expected live-lease surface, include both live and expired ledger rows, hold the ledger/time/serviced set fixed while varying non-ledger inputs, and separately demonstrate that the varied inputs affect the remainder of the document. This non-vacuously pins the stated justification that the published agent counts remain a projection of already-public live lease data. No trust check is weakened, no production control flow changes, and no hostile reviewer-directed instruction appears in the diff.
